runtime_proof.note: Measured read-only against production zfzdnfwdarxucxtaojxm. No row was written, updated or deleted; no containment setting, kill switch or delivery target was read or touched. An earlier draft of this bundle reported the raw approval-scope figure (10,882 of 21,870 suppressed picks, 49.8%, with no reason) without partitioning it. That figure is arithmetically correct and materially misleading, and it is corrected here: the entire approval-scope population is legacy/fixture, and the live pipeline writers miss a reason only 0.6-2.9% of the time.

queries.name: the approval-scope population is entirely legacy/fixture
queries.method: read-only SELECT over picks_current_state WHERE status = 'awaiting_approval' OR approval_status = 'pending', partitioned on the governed-cohort predicate metadata ? 'distributionMode'
queries.result: governed cohort: 0 rows. legacy/fixture: 21,870 suppressed, 10,882 without a usable reason, 2,075 held.
queries.significance: No genuine operator submission is currently sitting in approval scope, so the raw 49.8% blank-reason rate describes fixtures, not the product. Quoting it unpartitioned would have overstated the defect this lane renders.

queries.name: the live writers do record a reason; two fixture sources do not
queries.method: read-only SELECT over all suppressed picks grouped by source, counting null-or-blank promotion_reason
queries.result: system-pick-scanner 87/14,730 blank (0.6%); board-construction 19/1,100 (1.7%); alert-agent 45/4,341 (1.0%); model-driven 42/4,313 (1.0%); api 357/12,127 (2.9%); manual 0/4. Against that: smart-form 60,203/60,205 (99.997%) and t1-proof 2,146/2,146 (100%), every row predating 2026-07-30.
queries.significance: This is the honest shape of the defect. The real pipeline explains a suppression 97-99% of the time, so the red 'no reason recorded' cell will be rare on genuine rows and will mean something when it appears. A dash would have hidden exactly the 1-3% that matters, and the whitespace-aware blank check is what keeps a blank string from reading as an explanation.

queries.name: the held population is real and had no page of its own
queries.method: read-only SELECT over the same approval scope counting review_decision = 'hold', the exact predicate getHeldQueue applies
queries.significance: getHeldQueue already computed heldBy, ageHours and holdReason for these rows and no surface consumed them; the route named after the held queue was a redirect. This count is also fixture-dominated, and the page is correct regardless of which rows populate it.
